summary: Iteration 18 testing completed for Email Templates Module. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verification confirmed all 4 templates display correctly with Edit, Preview, and Reset functionality working properly. Quotes modification action 'Modificar (Nueva Versión)' is present in the dropdown menu.

issues: Console warnings: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

backend_email_templates_get.description: GET /api/email-templates returns 4 default templates: quote_sent, invoice, warehouse, implementation

backend_email_templates_update.description: PUT /api/email-templates/{template_id} updates template subject and body_html

backend_quotes_update.description: PUT /api/quotes/{quote_id} allows updates only for quotes in Borrador status

backend_quotes_duplicate.description: POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/duplicate creates new version with incremented version number

frontend_templates_section.description: Settings page has 'Plantillas de Correo Electrónico' section displaying all 4 templates with names, descriptions and subject previews

frontend_edit_modal.description: Edit button opens modal with subject input, body HTML textarea, variables list, and save/cancel buttons

frontend_variables_list.description: Edit modal shows clickable variable buttons: Número de Cotización, Nombre del Cliente, RIF del Cliente, Tipo de Cotización, Total USD, Nombre de la Empresa

frontend_preview.description: Vista Previa button shows email preview with sample data (COT-2024-001, Empresa Ejemplo C.A., VPOS, $1,500.00 USD)

frontend_quotes_modify_action.description: Quotes dropdown menu includes 'Modificar (Nueva Versión)' action to edit and create new version

critical_code_review_comments: All email template CRUD operations working correctly
DEFAULT_EMAIL_TEMPLATES constant provides fallback for templates not yet in DB
render_email_template function correctly replaces {variable} placeholders with values
EmailTemplatesEditor component properly implements edit, preview, and reset functionality
Quotes duplicate endpoint correctly increments version and sets parent_quote_id
PUT /quotes/{quote_id} properly validates Borrador status before allowing updates

test_credentials.note: Valid session from MongoDB user_sessions collection

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. Duplicate test created new quote version COT-2026-023.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified all email template functionality. Key test-ids: email-template-{id}, edit-template-{id}, reset-template-{id}, template-subject-input, template-body-input, save-template-btn. Templates section is in Settings page, requires scrolling down ~700px to see. The 4 templates are quote_sent, invoice, warehouse, implementation. Preview modal shows sample data with variables replaced. 'Modificar (Nueva Versión)' action in quotes dropdown opens wizard with data precargada and creates new version on save.
